output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are compared to hidden reference values (paper‑reported gold) with tolerances. The Seebeck curve and ZT are load‑bearing, forcing honest execution of the electronic structure and transport calculations. Structural sanity checks (positive moduli, C11 > C12 > 0, C44 > 0, 0 < ν < 0.5, A positive) act as gating criteria in the checker.
